texts.title: Connect teams
texts.intro: A tool call needs access to teams. What you enter is saved in ~/.usemcpkit/config.json and used for later calls.
texts.domainHint: Host, optionally with a port and path, without https://
texts.domainNewHost: New host, saved with its own credentials.
texts.savedBody: The credentials are saved in ~/.usemcpkit/config.json. This window closes by itself in a few seconds; you can also close it and go back to your MCP client.
texts.signingInBody: Approve access to teams in the sign-in tab that just opened. You can close this one.
texts.cancelledBody: Nothing was saved. The tool call that asked for credentials fails; calling it again reopens this form.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.hint: A client secret of that app (Certificates & secrets); its value is shown only when it is created. You can also set the TEAMS_APP_PASSWORD environment variable.

fields.label: Directory (tenant) ID
fields.hint: The Directory (tenant) ID of the app, on its Overview page. You can also set the TEAMS_APP_TENANT_ID environment variable.

fields.label: Team ID
fields.hint: The group id of the team: the groupId value in a link to the team or one of its channels (Get link in Teams). You can also set the TEAM_ID environment variable.

fields.label: Channel ID
fields.hint: The channel id, URL-escaped: the part after /channel/ in a link to the channel (Get link in Teams). You can also set the TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID environment variable.
